tray.background: Transfers continue in the notification area. Choose Exit from the TinyTorrent menu to stop.

exit.title: Exit TinyTorrent?
exit.active: Transfers are still active. Exiting will stop them.

notification.delete_failed: Files for {0} could not be fully deleted.
notification.missing_program: Torrents are set to open with a program that is missing: {0}. Select this to repair it in Settings.
notification.missing_programs: Torrents are set to open with programs that are missing: {0} and {1} more. Select this to repair them in Settings.

error.unknown: The operation could not be completed.
error.argument_sources: Registration actions cannot include torrent sources.
error.argument_exit: The --exit option cannot include other operations or torrent sources.
error.argument_repair: The --repair-class option cannot include other operations.
error.sources_limit: Too many torrent sources or source paths that are too long were supplied. Choose fewer sources or shorter paths.
error.engine_running: TinyTorrent is still running. Finish any open prompt or operation, then retry.
error.activation_refused: The running engine could not accept the request. Try again shortly.
error.registration_failed: Windows could not change TinyTorrent's startup or file-handling registration.
error.invalid_destination: Choose an existing, writable download folder.
error.shared_files: Other torrents use these files. Refresh the list and include them in the move.
error.destination_conflict: Different source files would occupy the same destination. Choose another folder or move these torrents separately.
error.destination_in_use: Another torrent uses files at this destination. Choose another folder to keep its files unchanged.
error.move_interrupted: The move was interrupted. Open Move files, choose the folder that now holds the files, and choose Use files there.
error.move_failed: The files could not be moved. Open Move files, choose the folder that now holds the files, and choose Use files there.
error.destination_exists: Files already exist at the destination. Open Move files and choose Use files there to verify and use them.
error.alias_conflict: Other torrents use these files with different names. Resolve the file names before continuing.
error.torrent_error: The torrent stopped because of an error.
error.storage_failed: Saved download state could not be read or written. Check the engine data folder and try again.
error.storage_overloaded: TinyTorrent is busy saving download state. Try again shortly.
error.checkpoint_failed: The download state could not be saved. Check the engine data folder and try again.
error.watch_limit: This watched folder contains more than 10,000 torrent files. Remove old source files or choose a smaller folder.
error.version: A different version of TinyTorrent is already running. Choose Exit in the tray, then start TinyTorrent again.
error.source: The torrent could not be added.
error.ownership: TinyTorrent cannot open its saved data. Another Windows logon may already be using this folder:
error.launch: The window could not start. Downloads continue. Choose Show window in the tray to retry.
error.startup: The window did not open. Downloads continue. Choose Show window in the tray to try again.
error.save: TinyTorrent could not save and remains running. Choose Exit in the tray to retry.
error.pause: The transfer pause setting could not be saved.
error.notification: The notification setting could not be saved.
error.window_open: The TinyTorrent window is still open. Close it, then retry.
error.unresponsive: The window did not respond to Exit. Nothing was discarded. Try Exit again when the window responds.
